name: Dark
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 3rd; Craft Magic Arms and Armor; disruption; Price +1 bonus.

DESCRIPTION

When activated, this enhancement inflicts an additional 1d6 points of negative energy damage to living creatures. Three times per day it can heal undead for 1d6 points of damage.
